trigger: operator provisions a role from policy-engine.md after rest-api.md was corrected
summary: Correcting rest-api.md left policy-engine.md contradicting it: a blanket 'They require the Policy:Read or Policy:Write RBAC permission' covered exactly the four routes just corrected to Policy:Delete / Policy:Execute, with no per-row override. Fixing one operator doc while its sibling states the old model is worse than leaving both wrong, because the two now disagree.
classification_rationale: Sibling doc states a permission model the code does not implement.

trigger: the response-example sweep covered permissions but not bodies
summary: rest-api.md:3683 and :3703 document "status": "enabled"/"disabled"; both handlers emit {"status":"ok"} (policy_admin_routes.cpp:243, :278). Same defect class this PR fixed 30 lines below for the invalidate pair, on the two routes the PR body named as 'checked as controls and left alone' - that check covered the PERMISSION only. The sweep was incomplete, not wrong.
classification_rationale: Documented response value contradicts the handler.

trigger: the round-1 fix declared per-row annotations authoritative and annotated only four rows
summary: Nine of thirteen rows lost their fallback answer and gained no annotation, trading correct blanket coverage for undefined. CONVERGENT: raised by consistency-auditor (Gate 4), unhappy-path (Gate 4, same wave) and security-guardian (Gate 8) independently.
classification_rationale: A stated authority that does not cover most of its own table.

trigger: the strengthened blanket sentence is readable as covering the HTMX Fragments table
summary: policy-engine.md's HTMX Fragments section lists /fragments/compliance/summary and /fragments/compliance/{policy_id}; compliance_routes.cpp gates both on auth_fn_ only, with no Policy permission. Asserting a Policy gate over them would document a control that does not exist. The absent gate is itself a known open issue (#4042), now cited in the section.
classification_rationale: Over-claim of a permission on routes that have none.

trigger: commit-message citation does not resolve to the claimed grant
summary: The original commit body cited rbac_store.cpp:792 and :813 for the PlatformEngineer and Operator Policy grants; correct lines are :793-794 and :813-814 (:792 is a different securable loop). The conclusion is unaffected and, per security-guardian, UNDERSTATED: PlatformEngineer holds Policy:Write but NOT Policy:Execute, so the old doc also over-promised invalidate to the role most likely to read it. Shipped artifacts carry no line numbers.
classification_rationale: Citation accuracy in a commit body; recorded rather than force-pushed over a live review.

trigger: the Permission: lines assume RBAC enabled; RBAC ships disabled
summary: With RBAC off the legacy branch requires admin for any non-Read, so granting Policy:Delete or Policy:Execute is inert; separately kServiceScopeGlobalSafe is empty, so a service-scoped token 403s regardless of grant. rest-api.md carries no preamble for either. Not worsened by this diff.
classification_rationale: Pre-existing framing gap; both docs are strictly more accurate than before.

trigger: fragment describes only the rest-api.md corrections
summary: Omits the policy-engine.md sibling-doc contradiction fixed in the hardening round.

trigger: ADR attributes these routes to the wrong source file
summary: Attributes the policy routes to compliance_routes.cpp; they live in policy_admin_routes.cpp. No permission stated, so no operator impact.

trigger: the shared worktree was switched between branches while agents were reading it
summary: consistency-auditor observed HEAD change from docs/rest-api-policy-gates to docs/rbac-count-corrections mid-review, so working-tree reads were silently wrong for a period. It re-did every read against explicit blobs and its findings are blob-verified. Cause: the orchestrator (me) ran git checkout in the same worktree the agents were reading. Later waves were instructed to read via git show only. A run whose inputs silently change is the failure mode Step 0's currency check exists to prevent, arriving by a different route.
classification_rationale: Defect in the run's own method, not in the diff; recorded so the next run does not repeat it.

trigger: Gate 8 re-review of the round-1 fix diff
summary: All four permission corrections re-verified against policy_admin_routes.cpp (:122, :192, :284, :321); heading-to-handler mapping confirmed with no mis-attachment across all 593 live route registrations; both response-example corrections confirmed; blanket sentence's claim that all four operations are independently gated confirmed. Gates 4 and 6 (happy-path, unhappy-path, consistency-auditor, compliance-officer, sre, enterprise-readiness) returned no blocking finding.
classification_rationale: Clean-bill record for the standing-rule-4 re-review.
